why.visual_craft: 9C3E keeps a consistent vertical rhythm throughout; B71F has a large unexplained empty band before the button row that reads as unfinished polish.
why.spacing_rhythm: B71F has a big dead gap between the '出所' line and Cancel/Edit/送る; 9C3E's gaps between title, fields, body, provenance and buttons are all similarly tight and intentional.
why.information_hierarchy: Same bold title, same field labels and same order in both, so the primary message ('このメッセージを送りますか?') and its content read equally clearly in 3 seconds.
why.preview_readability: Body text is the same size, weight and color with the same line length in both, equally easy to read.
why.provenance_visibility: The '出所' line is the same small gray weight and position relative to the body in both, visible without fighting the body text either way.
why.control_reachability: In B71F the buttons are pushed far below the provenance line by the dead gap, making them feel detached from the message they act on; in 9C3E the buttons sit close under the content, feeling directly tied to it.
why.screen_occupation: B71F's card is visibly taller due to the extra empty band, so it occupies more vertical screen space than 9C3E for identical content.
why.overall: 9C3E delivers the same information with tighter, more deliberate spacing and buttons that stay connected to the content, while B71F wastes space with a dead gap that hurts craft, rhythm and control reachability.

differences: B71F has a large empty vertical gap between the '出所 週次同期・田中・10:42' line and the Cancel/Edit/送る button row; 9C3E has only a small, consistent gap there.
B71F's overall card height is taller than 9C3E's for the same content, due to that gap.
B71F's background is a near-black/very dark tone, while 9C3E's background is a slightly lighter dark gray.
Text content, field labels (宛先/差出人/出所), colors (purple '# Slack' tag, orange '外部に出る' and '送る' button, blue 'Edit'), and layout order are otherwise identical.
content_lost: No text or element is missing from either image; both contain the same title, external-share notice, 宛先/差出人 fields, message body, provenance line, and Cancel/Edit/送る buttons.
